title: 托斯卡纳穹顶建筑
subtitle: 意大利 · 托斯卡纳 · 原始影像场景 5_CB

displayFilter.rule: Keep trained records with opacity >=0.015 and largest one-sigma scale <=0.1 times the navigation reference radius. Conservative presentation cleanup only; no points added or parameters changed.

credit: 古址天眸 · 本机训练 / 原始摄影：Pellis 等
description: 由本机对公开许可的历史建筑多视角照片重新训练生成。使用来源相机参数和建筑标注，本机完成特征匹配、三角化初始化与高斯优化；没有下载成品高斯模型，也没有使用单图深度表面替代。展示版仅过滤低透明度与超大浮点，完整训练文件另外保留。

training.validationCaveat: Architecture-region PSNR: resize prepared RGB and mask to exported render size with Pillow bilinear; use source mask >=254; RGB MSE on valid pixels, PSNR averaged over 20 withheld views. Native Brush whole-image metrics include untrained background and are retained separately. No geometric accuracy is implied. Best checkpoint selected by architecture-region validation PSNR.

preparation.method: Published camera poses and architectural labels; OpenCV undistortion; independent SIFT matching and two-view triangulation from training images only

source.selection: Evenly spaced photographs from all 166 source frames

preparation.maskPolicy: Source classes 0–9 retained; unknown/background class 10 ignored through separate loss masks, never forced transparent. One processed-pixel erosion. RGB and masks share undistortion. This avoids treating annotation gaps as physical holes.
preparation.validationPolicy: Every eighth photograph excluded from triangulation and training; source camera poses retained

camera.framing: Wide exterior camera-ray least-squares focus and 95th-percentile independently triangulated seed radius, keeping source camera height; navigation framing only, not a surveyed position

geometryPolicy: Source camera coordinates retained. Every learned Gaussian/SH field retained in complete raw PLY; exact unmodified records retained by display filter, no new geometry. Only photographed regions optimized; unseen portions not manufactured.
